newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Boral plans A$33 mln cement upgrade.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Boral plans A$33 mln cement upgrade.

text.p: Building materials and energy group Boral Ltd said on Monday it would spend A$33 million to upgrade its Blue Circle Southern Cement (BCSC) works at Berrima on the south coast of the state of New South Wales.
Boral said the upgrade would increase the annual capacity of the dry process kiln at Berrima by about 240,000 tonnes to almost one million tonnes a year.
"This upgrade will significantly reduce operating costs and enable BCSC to be internationally competitive in the Sydney market," the company said in a statement.
Boral said the upgrade primarily consisted of replacing the outmoded planetary coolers with a state-of-the-art grate cooler and related process modifications.
